Herb Bread

Makes 6 small loafs or 4 large loafs

Ingredients:

6 cups of all-purpose flour

1/2 cup warm water

1 1/2 tablespoons instant yeast

1 1/2 tablespoons white sugar

1 1/2 tablespoons olive oil

2 cups water

2 teaspoons salt

1 1/2 tablespoons oregano

1 1/2 tablespoons basil

1 teaspoon thyme

3 tablespoons water and 1 egg white, beaten to together

Step 1:

Proof the yeast by mixing the sugar and the 1/2 cup warm water and add the yeast. Let sit for 10 minutes.

Step 2:

Pour the yeast mixture into a large electric mixer and add 3 cups of flour. Add in all spices, salt, 1 cup of water, and the oil. After its mixed, add the last cup of water and the 3 cups of flour. Once the dough can be rolled into a ball shape (it will still be sticky to the touch), pull it out onto a floured surface and quickly kneed into a ball. let rest for 10 minutes and kneed again. Kneed every 10 minutes for one hour.

Step 3:

After the finally kneed, break the dough into four equal pieces (or six smaller, equal pieces). Flatten each piece into a rectangle and roll into a loaf. Place the loaves with the roll side down onto a baking pan and slice three slits into the top of the loaves. Paint the loaves with an egg white and water mixture (this will help with the final color). Preheat the oven to 215 degrees C (425 degrees F) Let the bread ride for 30 minutes during the preheat. Put the bread into the oven. After 10 minutes, lower the temperature to 190 degrees C (375 degrees F) and bake for another 20 minutes.

Step 4:

Pull out of the oven and enjoy!
